purpose: Start twelve real experiments opportunistically on GPU3 after foreign compute jobs release it; do not pause, kill, modify or reserve memory against their queue.
selection: Existing manifest order, not performance selection
bundle_meaning: Twelve simultaneously live real GPU3 experiments; aggregate admission required, no silent serial fallback
memory_budget: Each measured torch peak * 1.2 + 512 MiB CUDA/non-PyTorch reserve; plus 2048 MiB shared headroom; reserve pending process allocation
known_limitation: No exclusive reservation. Another launcher may race after the last admission check; no guarantee that it cannot launch.
